title: Syrian Braised Cabbage and Hearty Gratin
description: A hearty, comforting dish with the rich flavors of Syrian cuisine, featuring slow-cooked cabbage and a crispy gratin topping.
instructions: In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic, allspice, and cumin. Cook for 1 minute.
Add cabbage and cook until slightly tender, 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer cabbage mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread bechamel sauce evenly over the top of the cabbage.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
